title: Page 8
lines: 顾乔成喝了药，不想再看周屹天令人脑门抽痛的举止，早早回房歇下。
周屹天乐得在二楼陪赵小丫下棋。
赵小丫下得兴起，她的棋艺是周屹天教的，竹楼里也有几本棋谱，她没少拿来研读。
周屹天半卧在榻上，神情慵懒，注意力全不在棋盘上，只顾着打量她。
小丫头好学聪慧，说是过目不忘也不为过，他和老头子都曾暗自可惜，小丫就是出生在乡野，埋没了她的才气。
看她在烛光下拧眉思考，他不由得微扬了下嘴角，想起夏日在山上遇上她时，她不顾他的喝斥对他伸出援手。
转眼秋天过去，不过短短几个月，她却宛如脱胎换骨，身上不再见丝畏缩气息，虽说还是太痩，但多少长了点肉，看起来五官细致不少。
个分心，着不慎，周屹天竟败在赵小丫的手中。
赵小丫双眼闪着激动的光亮，这还是她初次得胜。
周屹天虽然好面子，但输了盘棋倒没恼，毕竟他心知他不是败在棋艺不精，而是美色误人。
他伸出手将她拉过来，用力啄了下她的唇，“赏你的。”
她的脸立刻火红，这人还真是无赖。
周岳见了，秉持着非礼勿视的道理，直接下了楼。
他走，周屹天索性将赵小丫抱到自己的腿上，一手搂着她，一手收着棋子，“可要再下盘？”
赵小丫心思微动，但最终还是摇头，“还是不了，天色已不早，你可得记得明日教我练拳。”
就她这小胳臂小腿，实在不是练武的料，但是她既开口提了，他便由着她，毕竟他明白
自己的身分，练几招功夫防身对她是有益无害。
“我记得。”他伸手捏了下她的脸，“只是别说练拳，你这是连走都不会就想跑。”
她不解的看着他，“不然我得先学什么？”
“扎马步。”他直接回答，“若扎得不好，其他都别提了。我告诉你，想当初我学的时候，老头子无良的在地上插香，让我在上头扎马步，若撑不住就被香烫了。”
赵小丫眨着眼，好奇的问：“那可曾烫着？”
周屹天狂妄的一哼，“周岳被烫得裤子都破了，但我是什么人？当然没有！”他不会承认，他确实没被烫，只不过是脚软的直接趴在地上。
反正现在不论周岳或老头子都不在，他说什么都成。
至于羞耻心，那是没有的事。
“哥哥真行。”赵小丫果然没有怀疑，崇拜的看着他，“若是我的话肯定不成。”
周屹天被她崇拜专注的眼神逗乐，大手扣住她的后颈，吻上她的唇。
每每这个时候，赵小丫都会敏感的察觉两人力量上的悬殊，但她心中毫无惧怕，因为她知道无论如何他都不会伤害自己。
第十章 暗夜袭击(1)
赵小丫睡得迷迷糊糊之际，被砰的一声巨响惊醒，立刻睁大眼睛。
四周一片漆黑，更显得外头刀剑相接的声响刺耳。
她的脸色一变，摸黑捉了放在一旁的湖蓝色衣衫穿上，靠着墙来到窗边，悄然掀开盖住窗户的兽皮，借着月色看见院外周屹天正在与三个黑衣人过招，再往回看就见院内也有三人对周岳发出凌厉攻势。
原本完好的竹栏倒下，上头躺着两个一动也不动的黑衣人。
周屹天下手毫不留情，出剑角度极度刁钻，纵使以一敌多，但解决不是难事，他一剑刺进跌倒在地的黑衣人胸口。
纵使隔了一段距离，赵小丫依然可见喷溅而出的鲜红血液。
院子里的周岳也解决了一人，但脚步一时不稳，跌落在地，露出了后背，千钧一发之际，周屹天用剑挡住了黑衣人砍下的大刀，周岳手上的剑也同时刺进黑衣人的肚子里。
另一名黑衣人趁这个机会一刀砍中周屹天的臂膀，血瞬间染红衣袖，但周屹天彷佛无所觉，一拳打在对方脸上，骨头断裂的声音在黑夜之中清晰可闻。
黑衣人搭住脸嚎叫着退了一大步，周屹天手中的剑挥过去，抹了对方脖子。
赵小丫从未见过如此血腥的场面，脸色苍白，偏偏竹林里又冒出了几个人，她心焦不安，想下楼却怕自己成为累赘，正在为难之际，楼下传来激烈的桌椅碰撞声。
想起受伤的顾乔成，她的脸更白了几分。
房内没有防身的武器，唯一有的是用来裁衣的铁剪，连犹豫都没有，她将铁剪紧握在手中，转身下楼。
藉着门外流泄的月色，赵小丫见到原本整齐洁净的厅堂乱成一团，两个黑衣人横倒在地，顾乔成一身血迹，吃力地应付面前的人。
顾乔成向来以自己力大无穷为傲，但旧伤未癒又添新伤，原本握在手中该是轻如纸片的大刀竟如有千斤重，如今杀了两个刺客已花尽他的力气，脚步失了以往的敏捷。
剩下的黑衣人见有机可乘，猛刺一刀，直入顾乔成胸膛。
赵小丫正好看到这一幕，瞪大眼，顾不得害怕，丢掉手中的铁剪，从地上已断气的黑衣人身旁拿起沾血的大刀，冲了上去。
黑衣人的刀没入顾乔成的胸膛，使劲正要下压，眼角余光看到阴影，心一惊，来不及闪躲，刀刃狠狠划过他的后背，传来一阵剧痛。
他怒得用力抽回刺进顾乔成胸前的大刀，转身砍了过去。
赵小丫险险挡住他挥来的刀，虎口一麻，手上的刀应声而落，人也跌在顾乔成的身旁。
黑暗之中看不清，但她落地时双手摸到黏稠湿热，知道这是顾乔成身上流下的鲜血，她挡在顾乔成的面前，将人护在身后。
“傻丫头。”顾乔成无力的推着她的后背，“快逃。”
赵小丫双目赤红，没有恐惧，只有满满的愤怒，用力摇着头，眼睁睁看着黑衣人对她一举大刀。
从外头冲进来的周屹天看到这一幕，黑眸闪现阴狠，一脚踢向黑衣人，将人踢倒在地。
这才看到倒在赵小丫身后的顾乔成，脑子先是一片空白，而后心神倶裂的嚎叫一声，剑光一闪，不留情的将地上的黑衣人杀了。
黑衣人的鲜血溅到脸上，赵小丫的身子不受控制的轻颤了下，目光木然的看着跟进来的黑衣人。
周屹天像疯了似的捡起地上的大刀，一刀一刀的舞动，鲜血染红他的衣裳和原本清幽的竹楼……
几乎同时，空中响起一阵刺耳的哨声。
赵小丫不知这是什么声响，就见原本像疯了似的周屹天恢复了些清明，忍着着硬咽低语，
隐约可以听见他说的是——
“老头子，你再忍忍……来了。顾良来了，没事的，不会有事的……”
果然他的声音才落下，竹林又窜出另一行黑衣人。
原本就已经被收拾得差不多的黑衣人看到对方的人来了，自知毫无胜算，立刻朝四周逃窜。
一道黑影闪进了竹楼，顾良跪在周屹天的面前，还未来得及开口，眼底血红一片的周屹天便痛心嘶吼，“追，捉活的！我要他们生不如死！”
顾乔成微眯着眼，看到顾良的身影，心安了，扯了下嘴角。
顾良看到面无血色的顾乔成，心一抽，手一抬，立刻带人追去。
“老头子！”周屹天双膝跪了下来，痛苦的低吼，“你答应了，你明明答应了，你要陪我回京！”
顾乔成颤抖的伸出手，周屹天立刻握住。
顾乔成有片刻的失神，想起了娘子死前交代他要好好养大闺女，偏偏他没护住人，原以为这辈子就算死也无颜下地府见发妻，但……曾经握在手中肥嫩而脆弱的小手，如今已成了足以撑住一切，护着自个儿的大手。
content_en:
Gu Qiaocheng drank the medicine and didn't want to see Zhou Yitian's headache-inducing behavior anymore, so he went back to his room to rest early.
Zhou Yitian was happy to play chess with Zhao Xiaoya on the second floor.
Zhao Xiaoya got excited about playing chess. Zhou Yitian taught her chess skills, and there were several chess books in the bamboo house, which she often used to study.
Zhou Yitian was half-lying on the couch with a lazy look on his face. His attention was not on the chessboard, he was only looking at her.
The little girl was eager to learn and smart, and it would be no exaggeration to say that she had a photographic memory. Both he and the old man secretly regretted that the little girl was born in the countryside, which buried her talent.
Seeing her frowning and thinking under the candlelight, he couldn't help but raise the corner of his mouth slightly, remembering that when he met her on the mountain in the summer, she helped him despite his scolding.
Autumn passed in the blink of an eye, but in just a few months, she seemed to have been completely transformed, and there was no longer any flinch in her body. Although she was still too thin, she had gained some flesh, and her facial features looked much more delicate.
Due to distraction and carelessness, Zhou Yitian was defeated at the hands of Zhao Xiaoya.
Zhao Xiaoya's eyes were shining with excitement. This was her first victory.
Although Zhou Yitian was saving face, he was not upset after losing the game of chess. After all, he knew in his heart that he was defeated not because of his poor chess skills, but because of his beauty.
He stretched out his hand to pull her over and pecked her lips hard, "It's for you."
Her face immediately turned red, this person was really a scoundrel.
When Zhou Yue saw this, he followed the principle of "don't look at anything inappropriate" and went downstairs.
When he left, Zhou Yitian simply put Zhao Xiaoya on his lap, hugged her with one hand, and collected the chess pieces with the other, "Do you want to play again?"
Zhao Xiaoya thought slightly, but finally shook her head, "It's still not possible. It's getting late. You must remember to teach me boxing tomorrow."
Her small arms and legs were really not suitable for martial arts training, but once she mentioned it, he let her go. After all, he understood
Given her identity, it would be beneficial for her to practice a few Kung Fu moves for self-defense.
"I remember." He reached out and pinched her face, "Just don't talk about boxing, you can't even walk and you want to run."
She looked at him puzzled, "Otherwise, what would I have to learn first?"
"Zama Step." He answered directly, "If it's not done well, forget about the rest. Let me tell you, when I first learned it, the old man unscrupulously put incense sticks on the ground and asked me to do the Horse Step on top. If I couldn't hold on, I was burned by the incense."
Zhao Xiaoya blinked and asked curiously: "Has it ever been burned?"
Zhou Yitian snorted arrogantly, "Zhou Yue was burned so hard that his pants were torn, but who am I? Of course not!" He would not admit that he was indeed not burned, but just lay on the ground with soft feet.
Anyway, neither Zhou Yue nor the old man is here now, so whatever he says will be accepted.
As for shame, there is no such thing.
"Brother is really good." Zhao Xiaoya really had no doubts and looked at him with admiration, "If it were me, it would definitely not work."
Zhou Yitian was amused by her adoring and focused eyes. He clasped the back of her neck with his big hands and kissed her lips.
At this time, Zhao Xiaoya would be sensitive to the disparity in strength between the two, but she had no fear in her heart because she knew that he would not hurt her no matter what.
Chapter 10 Dark Night Attack (1)
When Zhao Xiaoya was drowsily asleep, she was awakened by a loud bang and immediately opened her eyes wide.
The surroundings were dark, and the sound of swords clashing outside was even more harsh.
Her expression changed, and she grabbed the lake blue clothes she had put aside in the dark and put them on. She leaned against the wall and came to the window. She quietly opened the animal skin covering the window. Through the moonlight, she saw Zhou Yitian fighting three men in black outside the courtyard. Looking back, she saw three people in the courtyard launching a fierce offensive against Zhou Yue.
The originally intact bamboo fence fell down, and two motionless men in black lay on it.
Zhou Yitian struck without mercy, and the angle of his sword was extremely tricky. Even if there were more than one enemy, it was not difficult to deal with it. He thrust his sword into the chest of the man in black who fell to the ground.
Even after a distance, Zhao Xiaoya could still see the splash of bright red blood.
Zhou Yue in the yard also killed one person, but his steps were unsteady for a moment and he fell to the ground, exposing his back. At the critical moment, Zhou Yitian blocked the sword of the man in black with his sword, and the sword in Zhou Yue's hand also stabbed into the stomach of the man in black.
Another man in black took this opportunity to slash Zhou Yitian's arm. The blood instantly stained his sleeves red, but Zhou Yitian seemed unaware and punched the other man in the face. The sound of broken bones could be heard clearly in the dark night.
The man in black put his face on his face and took a big step back with a howl. Zhou Yitian swung the sword in his hand and wiped the other man's neck.
Zhao Xiaoya had never seen such a bloody scene, her face was pale, but a few people appeared in the bamboo forest. She was anxious and wanted to go downstairs but was afraid that she would become a burden. When she was in trouble, there was a fierce collision of tables and chairs downstairs.
Thinking of the injured Gu Qiaocheng, her face turned a little paler.
There were no weapons for self-defense in the room. The only ones she had were iron scissors for cutting clothes. Without even hesitation, she held the iron scissors tightly in her hands and turned around to go downstairs.
Through the moonlight leaking outside the door, Zhao Xiaoya saw that the originally neat and clean hall was in chaos. Two men in black fell to the ground. Gu Qiaocheng was covered in blood and struggled to deal with the people in front of him.
Gu Qiaocheng has always been proud of his immense strength, but the old wounds have not healed yet new ones have appeared. The sword that should have been as light as a piece of paper in his hand actually weighs a thousand pounds. Now that he has exhausted all his strength by killing two assassins, his steps have lost the agility he used to have.
Seeing an opportunity, the remaining man in black stabbed Gu Qiaocheng straight into the chest.
Zhao Xiaoya happened to see this scene, her eyes widened, and regardless of fear, she threw away the iron scissors in her hand, picked up the bloody sword from the side of the dead man in black on the ground, and rushed forward.
The man in black's knife sank into Gu Qiaocheng's chest, and when he was about to press down hard, he saw a shadow in the corner of his eye. He was startled, and before he had time to dodge, the blade slashed across his back, causing a sharp pain.
He was so angry that he withdrew the sword that had penetrated Gu Qiaocheng's chest, turned around and slashed at him.
Zhao Xiaoya narrowly blocked the knife he swung at, and the tiger's mouth was numb. The knife in his hand fell with a sound, and she also fell beside Gu Qiaocheng.
She couldn't see clearly in the darkness, but her hands felt sticky and hot when she landed. She knew it was the blood flowing from Gu Qiaocheng's body, so she stood in front of Gu Qiaocheng and protected him behind her.
"Silly girl." Gu Qiaocheng pushed her back weakly, "Run away."
Zhao Xiaoya's eyes were red, with no fear, only full of anger. She shook her head vigorously and watched helplessly as the man in black struck her with a sword.
Zhou Yitian, who rushed in from outside, saw this scene, his black eyes flashed with viciousness, and he kicked the man in black, knocking him to the ground.
Only then did he see Gu Qiaocheng lying behind Zhao Xiaoya. His mind went blank at first, and then he let out a heart-breaking howl. With a flash of sword light, he mercilessly killed the man in black on the ground.
The man in black's blood splashed on his face, and Zhao Xiaoya's body trembled uncontrollably, looking at the man in black who followed him blankly.
Zhou Yitian picked up the big knife on the ground like crazy, and danced it with one knife after another. The blood dyed his clothes and the originally quiet bamboo house red...
Almost at the same time, a harsh whistle sounded in the air.
Zhao Xiaoya didn't know what the sound was, but Zhou Yitian, who had been acting like crazy, regained some of his clarity, swallowed hard and whispered,
What you can vaguely hear him saying is——
"Old man, if you keep patiently...he's here. Gu Liang is here, it's okay, nothing will happen..."
Sure enough, just after his voice fell, another row of men in black emerged from the bamboo forest.
The men in black, who had already been sorted out, saw the other party's people coming, and knowing that they had no chance of winning, they immediately fled around.
A black shadow flashed into the bamboo building. Gu Liang knelt in front of Zhou Yitian. Before he could speak, Zhou Yitian, whose eyes were blood red, screamed in pain, "Chase them alive! I want them to live worse than death!"
Gu Qiaocheng squinted his eyes slightly, felt relieved when he saw Gu Liang's figure, and twitched the corner of his mouth.
When Gu Liang saw the bloodless Gu Qiaocheng, his heart twitched, he raised his hand and immediately led his men to chase him.
"Old man!" Zhou Yitian knelt down on his knees and growled in pain, "You agreed, you obviously agreed, you want to accompany me back to Beijing!"
Gu Qiaocheng stretched out his hand tremblingly, and Zhou Yitian immediately took it.
Gu Qiaocheng was absent-minded for a moment, remembering that his wife had told him before she died that he should raise his daughter well, but he failed to protect her. He originally thought that even if he died in this life, he would not be able to see his wife in the underworld, but... the fat and fragile little hand that he once held in his hand has now become a big hand that can support everything and protect himself.
